latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the auto-updater skill (v1.0.0).
- Automatically updates Clawdbot and all installed skills daily via cron.
- Sends the user a summary message detailing what was updated or if any issues occurred.
- Includes guidance for setup, configuration, troubleshooting, and manual operation.
- Supports both package manager and source installs for Clawdbot updates.
